scope: All B/C classifications at origin/main f32d5757c; audited full statements before promoting standing facts.

ordered_questions.question: Does the full statement contain a present standing assertion about team ownership, partner identity/roles/territory/persona, personal preference/capacity, organization service/posture, or another invariant independent of its action trigger?

Does the assertion supply standing person/team/organization context across tasks, or is it only a task-local technical/domain premise or requirement when doing X? Mixed rules pass if their factual premise remains useful independently of the prescribed task.

decision_procedure: Read the full statement, not its classification summary. Separate present factual premises from commands, illustrative examples, historical provenance and predictions.
If no present factual premise exists, leave B/C. If a factual premise exists, ask whether it defines durable/current person, team or organization context across exchanges.

Promote mixed factual/conditional statements when that independent contextual premise survives removing the action trigger. Leave technical capabilities, task routing, record/term definitions and workflow requirements whose premises are needed only in their own task.
Do not infer that a dated current-state fact has expired. Flag an explicit expiry condition for subsequent verified update; audit does not mutate its source.
boundary_notes: Team asset ownership is distinct from workflow-lane ownership: vendor network ownership promotes; weekly-vs-daily content lane ownership stays conditional.
Organization service model is distinct from a document’s rules: CARR buyer/tenant-only promotes; LOI template negotiation semantics stays conditional.
Explicit partner persona/preference is distinct from a workflow rationale: visual thinkers and Joe’s mobility preference promote; command-handoff trust rationale stays at its command action point.
Licensure 5697071b has a recorded expiry event requiring a verified outcome; no passage-of-time inference was made.
ede4b241 is proposed and absent from the live active snapshot; audited from committed full-text corpus as instructed, without treating it as active.
